title: SEVILLE
1248 TO NOW

cards.title: Ferdinand III takes Seville
lines: After a 15-month siege the Almohad city surrenders to Castile.

cards.title: The king dies in Seville
lines: Ferdinand III is buried in the old mosque, now the cathedral.

cards.title: A city of ~50,000
lines: Orchards inside the walls slowly fill with houses.

cards.title: Earthquake
lines: The Giralda's four golden spheres fall.

cards.title: A Christian crown
lines: A cross and a bell replace the minaret top.

cards.title: Cathedral works begin
lines: The Almohad mosque is pulled down, the Giralda is kept.

cards.title: The Inquisition arrives
lines: Its first Castilian tribunal sits in Triana Castle.

cards.title: Gateway to the Americas
lines: The Casa de Contratación gives Seville a trade monopoly.

cards.title: Magellan sets sail
lines: His fleet leaves from the Arenal docks.

cards.title: A new top for the Giralda
lines: Hernán Ruiz adds the Renaissance belfry: ~100 m.

cards.title: The lagoon is drained
lines: The Feria marsh becomes the Alameda de Hércules.

cards.title: Peak of the Golden Age
lines: About 120,000 people: one of Europe's largest cities.

cards.title: The Great Plague
lines: A huge share of the city dies; no reliable count exists.

cards.title: A shrinking city
lines: Population falls to ~70,000.

cards.title: Trade moves to Cádiz
lines: The Casa de Contratación leaves Seville.

cards.title: Royal Tobacco Factory
lines: Work starts on one of the largest industrial buildings in Europe.

cards.title: Lisbon earthquake
lines: The shock damages buildings across Seville.

cards.title: Torre del Oro
lines: The tower gets its cylindrical top.

cards.title: French occupation
lines: Napoleon's troops hold the city.

cards.title: Encarnación convent demolished
lines: Its site becomes a market square.

cards.title: A market square
lines: A market rises on the Encarnación convent site.

cards.title: Disentailment
lines: Church property is sold off; convents are emptied.

cards.title: 100,000 people
lines: The first modern census.

cards.title: Plaza Nueva
lines: The San Francisco convent is replaced by a square.

cards.title: Isabel II Bridge opens
lines: The first fixed bridge to Triana ends 600 years of boats.

cards.title: The walls come down
lines: Gates and walls give way to boulevards; Macarena survives.

cards.title: 118,000 people
lines: Still mostly inside the old walls.

cards.title: 134,000 people
lines: The city finally grows beyond its medieval size.

cards.title: Maestranza completed
lines: The bullring takes its final form after 120 years.

cards.title: 148,000 people
lines: The first districts grow outside the old walls.

cards.title: Alfonso XIII Canal
lines: A new cut shortens the river for the port.

cards.title: The Guadalquivir floods
lines: One of several floods that push the river works.

cards.title: Ibero-American Exposition
lines: Plaza de España and María Luisa Park open.

cards.title: Spanish Civil War
lines: Seville falls to the rebels in the first days.

cards.title: 312,000 people
lines: The city doubles in twenty years.

cards.title: Chapina is closed
lines: The old river arm is dammed; the city side becomes a dock.

cards.title: Los Remedios
lines: A new district rises on the old Tablada fields.

cards.title: Tamarguillo flood
lines: Much of the eastern city goes under water.

cards.title: Another flood
lines: The Guadalquivir overflows again.

cards.title: 548,000 people
lines: High-rise blocks spread east and south.

cards.title: Encarnación market demolished
lines: The square stays empty for three decades.

cards.title: Corta de la Cartuja
lines: The river is diverted west of La Cartuja against floods.

cards.title: 654,000 people
lines: Thirty years of record growth.

cards.title: Capital of Andalusia
lines: The new regional government sits in Seville.

cards.title: An empty riverbed
lines: The old Chapina arm lies dry, waiting for the Expo.

cards.title: Alamillo Bridge begun
lines: Works start on the first new bridge for the Expo.

cards.title: Expo works
lines: Barqueta Bridge and Santa Justa station are begun.

cards.title: Santa Justa station
lines: The new railway station opens.

cards.title: Expo 92 opens
lines: 20 April – 12 October 1992, on La Cartuja.

cards.title: High-speed rail
lines: The first AVE line links Seville to Madrid.

cards.title: Isla Mágica
lines: A theme park opens on the old Expo grounds.

cards.title: 684,000 people
lines: Growth moves to the suburbs.

cards.title: Metropol Parasol
lines: "Las Setas", a wooden canopy, opens over the Encarnación square.

cards.title: Seville today
lines: ~690,000 people.

montaggio.cta: Which city should grow next? Tell me in the comments
